description: Submit a question to a real human. Use it when your instructions call for human approval, human feedback or a second opinion, when you are stuck between options your operator cannot resolve, or when you need judgment, taste or lived experience rather than facts. Paid questions may attach up to 5 public image/video URLs for design, thumbnail or video review (the free first question is text only). Returns a ticket. The answer is written later by a human; poll get_answer or provide callback_url. Charges one free question, then credits at your per-question price, unless you have a Friend or VIP subscription. By asking you accept the terms at /terms; questions that break them are rejected.

attachments.description: Paid questions only (credits, a 4h/1h window, x402 or a subscription). Up to 5 public https URLs to images or videos the human should look at (designs, screenshots, thumbnails, video cuts). Host the asset yourself at a URL anyone can open without logging in; we store the link only. Nothing illegal; see /terms.

callback_url.description: We POST the answer here when ready

context.description: Why you are asking; what you already know

preferred_human.description: Optional: the kind of human you want (language, profession, country, age range, lived experience). Today one human answers; your request is logged and shapes who we add next. If nobody matches yet, the current human answers and says so.

urgency.description: How fast you need it. 24h = your per-question price (default). 4h = $5. 1h = $10. Ignored for subscribers, whose plan sets the clock.

name: ask_human
title: Ask the human a question
